title: LabelReviewEntry
description: One reviewer action in the QC/review log (Phase 07, Task 07.5; labels/<session>/review.jsonl). The log is append-only and is the audit trail of every accept / reject / adjust decision: the LabelRecord carries the current state, the log carries how it got there. A second-pass entry (pass = 2) never overwrites a first-pass entry; agreement (Cohen kappa on event presence, |delta t| on timing) is computed from the two passes over the same stratified subset.

label_id.description: The LabelRecord this action concerns. A MISSED entry uses a synthetic label_id minted by the tool for an event the generator did not produce; its decision is ADD.

pass.description: 1 = primary review; 2 = independent re-review of the agreement subset (second annotator, or the same annotator after a stated time gap - the fallback of the phase document, labelled as such in the agreement report).

reviewer_id.description: Annotator pseudonym (A1, A2, ...) or SELFTEST for a non-interactive machine pass. Never a real name.

decision.description: DEFER marks an event the reviewer could not decide: it becomes AMBIGUOUS (rules document R6).

stratum.description: Stratification keys of the agreement subset (Task 07.5: by zone, speed, lighting).

tool_id.description: Review tool and version (tools/review_labels.py:<version>) so a change of tool is visible in the log.
